title: Spectral scalar-curvature control of width in dimension three
exact_target: If a connected complete smooth three-manifold without boundary satisfies $\int (4|\nabla \varphi |^{2}+Scal\cdot \varphi ^{2})\geq \lambda \int \varphi ^{2}$ for some $\lambda >0$ and every compactly supported real smooth $\varphi $, must there be a continuous map to a one-dimensional simplicial complex whose every fiber has diameter at most $500/\surd \lambda $?
